data.short_description: A new food-and-drink concept called The Beach House is set to open inside a newly built pavilion at Cupsogue Beach County Park, more than a decade after a 2014 fire destroyed the original structure. The $8.75 million pavilion project also includes upgraded restrooms, concession space, and facilities for EMT and lifeguard operations. The Beach House will be operated by Elyse Grasso, Mikaela Fiscina, Matthew Spinks, and Jay and Katchlin Janowsky.

data.status: expansion blocked; no work carried out
data.short_description: The Hotel S'Incantu in Villasimius sought authorization to expand its building volume and add a restaurant, but the Superintendency of Archaeology and Fine Arts issued negative opinions, ultimately blocking the project. A Regional Administrative Court ruled the Superintendency's opinions were illegitimate and ordered it to pay over €700,000 in damages. The regulation that would have allowed the expansion expired during the proceedings, meaning no construction took place.
